system.description:
ATTACK CLASS FLOURISH GYMNAST MOVEMENT

You push off walls, creatures, or momentum to string attacks together.

Prerequisites Vaulting Momentum

Action 2 AP

After taking an action with the Movement trait (not a step), you may make two separate melee attacks against two targets with reach. These attacks effect your multiple attack penalty normally, but not until after they have been resolved.

Automated: press Use after a Movement action this turn other than a Step (a Stride, a Tumble, a jump …): 2 AP for two melee Strikes against two different creatures, both within your reach. Both are made at the multiple attack penalty that stands when you use it; the penalty then rises by two.
